data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for live metrics visualization.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays LLM cost over time using a line chart
Stage completion rates are shown with a bar chart
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart

features.title: Chart.js Visualization Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize various metrics such as pipeline stages, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using a Chart.js chart
Cost tracking is displayed with a relevant chart type
Success rates are shown using an appropriate chart

features.title: Professional Design and Transitions
features.description: Implement a professional design with gradient backgrounds and smooth slide transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a professional gradient background
Slides transition smoothly with animations
Design is consistent across all slides

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls for manual progression.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration
Users can manually navigate through slides
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive

features.title: HTML Presentation Setup
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML file
Chart.js library is included and functional

features.title: Supervisor Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Integration stages are accurately represented in a pie chart
Chart is interactive and visually clear
Data is correctly sourced from recent runs

features.title: Code Quality Metrics Display
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart accurately displays code quality metrics
Metrics include TDD compliance and SOLID principles
Chart is visually clear and informative
